publication.title: Vocabulary for linked data visualization model

source_reading.scope: All substantive sections: motivation, data-source/analysis/view model, concrete compatibility semantics, vocabulary/templates/ports/configuration, worked SPARQL analyzer and nested-pipeline examples, discussion/conclusion. No new interface evaluation established.

adjudication.basis: The new LDVM vocabulary specifies a concrete RDF-data-to-view guidance method: input descriptors are SPARQL tests, output samples expose compatible classes/properties, mandatory and optional features determine compatible components, and nested pipelines make expert configurations reusable. Actual RDF datasets are the analytical input. The report qualifies as a proposed method through the guidance route; it does not demonstrate a new current Payola interface or a new usability experiment.
